# HELP fps_sessions_attempted_total Sessions that the engine started. Unit sessions.
# TYPE fps_sessions_attempted_total counter

fps_sessions_attempted_total{run_id="run-2",application="http1",scenario="web_get"} 40
# HELP fps_sessions_failed_total Sessions that ended with a failed or timed out action, by failure reason. Unit sessions.
# TYPE fps_sessions_failed_total counter
fps_sessions_failed_total{run_id="run-2",application="http1",reason="expect_timeout",scenario="web_get"} 4
# HELP fps_sessions_failed_ratio Fraction of attempted sessions that failed. Test criteria use it without labels for the whole run. Unit ratio.
# TYPE fps_sessions_failed_ratio gauge
fps_sessions_failed_ratio{run_id="run-1",application="http1",scenario="web_get"} 0
fps_sessions_failed_ratio{run_id="run-2",application="http1",scenario="web_get"} 0.1
# HELP fps_sessions_concurrent Sessions open at the sample instant. Unit sessions.
# TYPE fps_sessions_concurrent gauge
fps_sessions_concurrent{run_id="run-2",application="http1",scenario="web_get"} 3.5
# HELP fps_throughput_bps Application payload throughput in both directions over the last sample interval. Unit bits_per_second.
# TYPE fps_throughput_bps gauge
fps_throughput_bps{run_id="run-2",application="http1",scenario="web_get"} +Inf
# HELP fps_tcp_rtt Smoothed round trip time samples of TCP sessions. Unit us. Quantiles of the HDR histogram.
